items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Late old NSH Ristar playing. That's right. And you were young then? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] I used to go up on the Winter Garden. He was Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver played up there.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well, I used to listen to, I believe it was the Imperial man with Manuel Réa and Pico. And then... Was Pico playing with us? He was playing the clarinet with Manuel Réa. They used to play at the old fros and I remember most of the time.
Late old NSH Ristar playing. That's right. And you were young then? Yeah.
I used to go up on the Winter Garden. He was Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver played up there. Remember that was Winter Garden.
